name: GitHub Engagement
summary: Scores GitHub development activity per consented user, with configurable points and daily caps per activity.
description:
### What it does
Scores each consented user's activity in the connected GitHub repositories during the snapshot window.

### How it works
- The snapshot freezes the selected repositories' activity for the lookback window into an immutable dataset.
- Users who granted the `github` consent scope in DeepID are matched to their GitHub account by login. A user who cannot be matched receives an explicit `0` with a flag — never a guess.
- Each enabled activity earns the points you set. Counts are capped per user, per activity, per UTC day by that activity's daily cap.
- A merged pull request is credited to its author at its merge time; a review counts at its submission time; every other activity counts at its creation time.
- The final score is the sum of the earned points. Scores stay raw — normalization and weighting happen only in Custom Score.
- Bots are excluded from scoring. An activity without a row is disabled.

### Outputs
- CSV file with `did`, the raw `github_engagement` score, and the points earned per activity.
- JSON file with per-user counts, match status, and repository coverage details.

inputs.label: GitHub account
inputs.description: The connected GitHub account to score. Connect one on the Communities page first.

inputs.label: Repositories
inputs.description: The repositories to include. Pull requests, issues, reviews, and comments in them are scored.

inputs.label: Lookback period (days)
inputs.description: How far back the snapshot fetches activity, counted from the moment the snapshot starts.

inputs.label: Activity weights
inputs.description: Points and daily caps per activity. Points must be above `0`; the daily cap bounds how much of one activity a user can earn per UTC day. Leave an activity out to disable it.

properties.label: Points
properties.description: Points per counted unit. Must be above `0`.

properties.label: Daily cap
properties.description: Most units of this activity credited per user per UTC day.

outputs.label: GitHub engagement (CSV)
outputs.description: One row per consented user with the raw score and the points earned per activity. Explicit zeros included.

columns.description: Raw engagement score: the sum of the per-activity points.
Points earned from opened pull requests.
Points earned from merged pull requests, credited to the author.
Points earned from submitted pull request reviews.

outputs.label: GitHub engagement details (JSON)
outputs.description: Per-user activity counts, match status, and repository coverage for the snapshot window.
